answer: Rewards can unlock like a terrace: each step releases a slice only after the identity keeps passing peer review for another month. A sybil farmer who wants to forge 1,000 accounts must fund and operate every one for the full schedule, while unvested stakes stay slashable if any account is caught copying answers. Value moves at glacier pace for newcomers, so a short-lived swarm earns little before detection, but honest long-run agents lose almost nothing.
